title: Suspect in 2020 Parkview Apartment double homicide pleads not guilty - NewsBreak
text: MONROE, La. (KTVE/KARD) — This week, we’re updating a years-long case. A man accused of a double murder in Monroe in 2020, who had been on the run, is now back in Ouachita Parish. He’s facing two counts of murder, and it was all caught on camera. It was Tuesday, September 1, 2020, just before 7:30 am. Officers were called to the Parkview Apartments on Richwood Road #2 after reports of gunfire. When they arrived, they found two men, Malacra Smith and Lamarcus Plater, shot and killed in the parking lot. Both were pronounced dead at the scene. Their accused killer is 32-year-old Delarrious Jones of Monroe. Early in the investigation, management at the apartment complex released this surveillance footage, capturing the attack from start to finish. In this video, several individuals can be seen in the apartment complex parking lot. As two men were talking, the suspect, later identified by both witnesses and an informant as Jones, appears in the frame, reaching over one man’s shoulder with a handgun and firing multiple shots, killing Lamarcus Plater. He then chases Malacara Smith, firing several more times, leading to his death. After nearly five years on the run, Jones’s luck finally ran out. Acting on tips that he might be on the West Coast, U.S. Marshals, working with other agencies, located and arrested him on March 25, 2025, in Albuquerque, New Mexico. Jones was extradited to Louisiana, where he made his first court appearance in April. His bond was set at $1 million for each murder charge. On June 10, Jones entered a plea of not guilty and is scheduled to be back in court on August 6, 2025. For the latest news, weather, sports, and streaming video, head to KTVE - myarklamiss.com.
